name: Aki Kanoko
source: Haruchika's childhood friend who is shy but very kind. She works part-time at her father's coffee shop "Momija", and due to this, is good at brewing all kinds of coffee. However, she is bad at cooking and is referred to as "Devil Kanoko" whenever she cooks something.
translation: Haruchika's childhood friend who is shy but very kind. She works part-time at her father's coffee shop "Momija", and due to this, is good at brewing all kinds of coffee. However, she is bad at cooking and is referred to as "Devil Kanoko" whenever she cooks something.
